### ✅ **ACTION 1: GENERATE & SEND STAKEHOLDER NOTIFICATIONS**

#### 🔹 Slack Notification
- **Source**: `gs://migration-secrets/slack-webhook.json`  
- **Payload**:
```json
{
  "text": "✅ *Cutover Success*: Data warehouse migration completed successfully at 2025-04-11T22:00:00Z UTC.\n\n• Data Quality Score: 0.993 (DQ-SCORE-099)\n• GPG-signed approval: jane.doe@company.com\n• Final audit trail sealed with WORM enforcement\n• Jira ticket CR#2025-0411 closed\n\nMigration is now live and fully operational.",
  "username": "Migration Bot",
  "icon_emoji": ":rocket:"
}
```
- **Action**: POST to webhook URL extracted from `gs://migration-secrets/slack-webhook.json`  
- **Verification**: Confirm HTTP 200 response + log timestamped success in audit log

#### 🔹 Email Notification via AWS SES
- **Config Source**: `gs://migration-secrets/email-smtp-config.json`  
- **Template**:
```plaintext
Subject: [SUCCESS] Cutover Completed – CR#2025-0411 – Data Warehouse Migration

Dear Stakeholders,

The data warehouse migration has been successfully completed at 2025-04-11T22:00:00Z UTC.

Key details:
- Data Quality Score: 0.993 (meets DQ-SCORE-099)
- Approved by: jane.doe@company.com (GPG verified)
- Audit trail archived with WORM policy
- Jira ticket CR#2025-0411 marked as closed

The system is now live and ready for production use.

Best regards,  
Migration Automation System
```
- **Action**: Use AWS SES SDK with credentials from `email-smtp-config.json` to send to list in `gs://migration-secrets/stakeholder-emails.txt`  
- **Validation**: Confirm message ID returned; record in `gs://migration-audit/notifications-sent-20250411.json`

---

### ✅ **ACTION 2: UPDATE RUNBOOK**

- **Target File**: `gs://migration-docs/runbooks/migration-handoff-v2.1.md`  
- **Update Required**:
```markdown
## Migration Status Summary

- **Cutover Status**: `completed`
- **Cutover Timestamp**: `2025-04-11T22:00:00Z`
- **Final DQ Score**: `0.993`
- **Approval Key**: `jane.doe@company.com`
- **Audit Trail**: Sealed at `gs://migration-audit/cutover-final-record-20250411.json`
- **Compliance Package**: Stored at `gs://migration-compliance/compliance-package-jane-doe-20250411.tar.gz` + `.p7s`

> ✅ All steps executed. No further actions required unless new change request.
```
- **Action**: Append update using `gsutil cp` with `--if-generation-match=latest` to prevent race conditions  
- **Verification**: Confirm file hash matches expected checksum (`sha256sum`) stored in `gs://migration-checksums/runbook-v2.1-checksum.txt`

---

### ✅ **ACTION 3: SCHEDULE POST-MORTEM REVIEW**

- **Jira Ticket Creation**:
  - **Project**: `CR` (Change Request)
  - **Issue Type**: `Task`
  - **Summary**: `POST-MORTEM: CR#2025-0411 – Review & Lessons Learned`
  - **Description**:
    > Post-cutover review scheduled for next business day. Objective: Document successes, identify edge cases, and refine future automation.
    >
    > Due: `2025-04-12T08:00:00Z UTC`
    >
    > Attached: `cutover-report-20250411.json`, `audit-final-record-20250411.json`
  - **Assignee**: `automated-review-team@company.com` (default)
  - **Labels**: `postmortem`, `migration`, `auto-generated`

- **Action**: Use Jira REST API (`POST /rest/api/3/issue`) with OAuth2 token from `gs://migration-secrets/jira-oauth-token.json`  
- **Validation**: Confirm issue key returned (e.g., `CR-12345`) and log in `gs://migration-audit/postmortem-scheduled-20250411.json`

---

### 🟢 **FINAL VERIFICATION & ARCHIVAL**

- **Audit Log Update**:
  ```json
  {
    "action": "final_handoff_complete",
    "timestamp": "2025-04-11T22:05:00Z",
    "performed_by": "automation-system",
    "details": {
      "notifications_sent": ["slack", "email"],
      "runbook_updated": "gs://migration-docs/runbooks/migration-handoff-v2.1.md",
      "postmortem_scheduled": "CR-12345",
      "final_report": "gs://migration-reports/cutover-report-20250411.json"
    }
  }
  ```
  - Write to `gs://migration-audit/final-handoff-complete-20250411.json` with WORM enforcement

- **WORM Enforcement Check**:
  - Confirm bucket `gs://migration-archive/` has `retention-period = 7 years`, `locked = true`  
  - Verify all artifacts are immutable and cannot be modified or deleted

---
